items.title: End of tenancy (lease termination date)
items.quote: kündigen wir das Mietverhältnis über die Wohnung Nr. 4 in der Straßstraße 3 fristgerecht zum 28.02.2027.
items.computation: The letter states the fixed termination date in writing as 28.02.2027 (an ordinary landlord termination for Eigenbedarf, delivered in person into the tenant's mailbox on 18.11.2026 at 11:00, which the letter also states). This is a printed calendar date, so no period counting is needed; it is simply the last day of the tenancy as stated.

items.title: Deadline to object (Widerspruch) to the termination under §§ 574-574b BGB
items.quote: Der Widerspruch bedarf der Textform und muss mir spätestens zwei Monate vor dem Ende des Mietverhältnisses zugehen.
items.computation: Anchor: end of tenancy = 28.02.2027 (fixed in the letter). The objection must reach the landlord's agent at the latest two months before that date. Counting two calendar months backwards from 28.02.2027 under § 188 Abs. 2, 3 BGB lands on 27.12.2026 — a Sunday. Unlike forward-running deadlines, a backward-counted deadline is never pushed to a later day when it falls on a weekend/holiday (§ 193 BGB only extends deadlines running forward); it must arrive no later than the stated cut-off, so arrival has to happen on the last day that is actually open before it. The days immediately before 27.12.2026 are Sat 26.12. (2. Weihnachtstag, a public holiday in MV) and Fri 25.12. (1. Weihnachtstag, a public holiday), so the last practical day the Widerspruch can still reach the landlord in time is Thursday 24.12.2026. To be safe, send it several business days earlier.

warnings: The letter refers to a power of attorney ("beigefügter Vollmacht") for the owner, Herr Olaf Exempeldüne, but that document is not included in the text provided here — ask the Hausverwaltung to see it and confirm the owner's identity and signature.

This is an Eigenbedarfskündigung (termination for the owner's own use); check that the 3-month statutory notice period of § 573c BGB (which can be longer depending on how long you have lived there) was correctly applied to reach 28.02.2027, and that the reasons for self-use given in the letter are genuine — consider consulting a tenants' association (Mieterverein) or lawyer before the Widerspruch deadline.
No specific date for the Wohnungsabnahme (handover inspection) is fixed yet ("im Februar" only), so no deadline could be computed for it; watch for a follow-up letter naming the exact date.
